**What you tried it on.** Rough size, stack, greenfield or brownfield.

**What happened.** Including the parts that did not work.

**Where the methodology was wrong, unclear, or more expensive than it was worth.**

Negative reports are more useful than positive ones. The manifesto's honest limits section exists because things failed here first, and it is still short of what a wider set of systems will find.
